description: 'Backup Service' means two different things in two trees. In server/ it is one of the seven Couchbase Server services. In cloud/ the phrase occurs exactly once - cloud/clusters/cloud-snapshots.md, 'Your CSP's backup service' - and refers to the cloud provider's snapshot facility, which is not a Couchbase service at all. A reader searching the combined documentation for 'Backup Service' gets both, undifferentiated. Recorded in the service:backup-service registry entry as a do-not-confuse warning. This is the fifth name collision the POC has documented and the first that spans products rather than sitting inside one.
